title: Translated labels lie in the statement support
statement: Let $c$ be a program in the partial-recursive language, and let $l$ be an optional label. If $l$ belongs to the label support of $c$'s compilation with the halt label adjoined, then the translation of $l$ belongs to the finite statement support of the compiled program.
hypotheses_covered: A program $c$ in the partial-recursive language
The label $l$ belongs to the compilation's label support with the halt label adjoined
replaced:
For every optional label drawn from the label support of the compiled program with
the halt label adjoined, the statement obtained by translating that label belongs to
the finite statement support of the program.
